title: 第二十三章 土鸡瓦狗第二十四章 庄主出马
content_zh:
瞬息之间打出了七八拳，拳拳入肉，这位赵家庄威风八面的执事顿时如一口人肉沙袋，在半空中被活活打爆，最后一拳，更是连肥胖的躯体都被打飞到了悬崖之外。
跟赵杭一样，尸骨无存。
收拳，转身。
叶枫风轻云淡，傲立七尺身躯，看着数丈外呆滞住了的赵仑，嘴角一抽，露出一抹冷笑。
“你敢不听本公子号令！”
好像被踩了尾巴的老虎，赵仑发出愤怒咆哮声，脸色扭曲到了难以想象的程度。
“那又如何！”
看了他一眼后，叶枫转身离去。
挞挞挞……
每一步都迈得缓慢而沉重，好像一柄巨锤在不断捶动赵仑的心，他脸上肌肉绷紧，一只按在腰间长剑上的手微微颤抖，有种狠狠教训一下叶枫的冲动。
不过赵仑终究没有这个勇气。
轻描淡写击杀赵天乐，叶枫呈现出来的实力让他动容，一对一之下，赵仑自觉没有必胜把握，就算胜了，也势必是惨胜，飞云宗开宗收徒这件大事迫在眉睫，无论如何，他都不想在此刻平生事端，让自己受伤。
“废物，叶枫，我会让你后悔终身，一定会……”
赵仑的额头蹦起青筋，气急败坏。
他从来没有想过，这小废物会张狂到了这样的程度，居然连他都给无视了。
“有能耐就出手……”
叶枫没有回头，冷冷丢下这几个字。
现在不出手，就表示赵仑将失去最后的机会，以后再没有胜过自己的可能了。
可惜色厉内荏的赵仑，只会用咆哮发泄不满，像这样的公子哥，没有经历过大挫折，根本无法摆正自己的位置。
叶枫已不将他放在眼中。

世界上的绝大多数人，都下意识的认为自己是不一样的那个，哪怕废物也这么认为。
赵仑就觉得自己与众不同，一定会走出赵家庄这个乡下地方，加入宗门，成为绝世高手。
所以他还在心中勉强安慰自己，只要忍住这口气，等自己修为提升了，再掉过头来对付叶枫，让叶枫为今天的所作所为付出沉痛代价。
可惜，你在进步的同时人家也在进步，而且人家进步的速度远超你的想象……
……
赵家庄。
叶枫所住的破屋门外，人头涌动，上百个赵姓族人围成一团，气势汹汹。
“叶枫，你偷袭杀死执事，还有赵杭、赵火赵勇，罪该万死！”
“快滚出来，要不然我们一把火烧了你这狗窝。”
“废物，垃圾……”
“必须要血债血偿。”
之前赵杭等人失踪，赵家庄人心惶惶，还以为大黑林中跑出了什么厉害的妖兽。
没想到刚才传来消息，是叶枫杀了他们，这叶枫甚至还杀死了赵执事，乃是少爷赵仑亲眼所见。
这一下子，整个赵家庄炸开了锅，短短一个时辰不到就聚集了上百赵姓族人，群情激昂，恨不得把他碎尸万段。
content_en:
In the blink of an eye, seven or eight punches were thrown, and the punches penetrated the flesh. The majestic deacon of Zhaojiazhuang was suddenly like a human sandbag, beaten alive in mid-air, and with the last punch, even his fat body was blown away from the cliff.
Just like Zhao Hang, no bones remain.
Hold your fist and turn around.
Ye Feng was calm and calm, standing proudly with his seven-foot body, looking at Zhao Lun who was stunned a few feet away, twitching the corner of his mouth and revealing a sneer.
"How dare you disobey my orders!"
Like a tiger whose tail was stepped on, Zhao Lun roared angrily, his face distorted to an unimaginable degree.
"So what!"
After looking at him, Ye Feng turned and left.
Tart tart tart…
Every step was slow and heavy, as if a giant hammer was beating Zhao Lun's heart. The muscles on his face were tense, and the hand on the sword at his waist was shaking slightly. He had the urge to teach Ye Feng a lesson.
But Zhao Lun did not have the courage after all.
After casually killing Zhao Tianle, he was moved by the strength Ye Feng showed. In one-on-one, Zhao Lun felt that he was not sure of victory. Even if he won, it would be a tragic victory. The major event of Feiyun Sect opening a sect and recruiting disciples was imminent. No matter what, he did not want to get hurt at this moment in his life.
"Trash, Ye Feng, I will make you regret it for the rest of your life, I will definitely..."
Zhao Lun's forehead had veins popping up and he was furious.
He never thought that this little loser would be so arrogant that he would even ignore him.
"If you have the ability, take action..."
Ye Feng did not look back and dropped these words coldly.
If he doesn't take action now, it means that Zhao Lun will lose his last chance and will never be able to defeat him in the future.
It's a pity that Zhao Lun, who is fierce in appearance and soft in heart, can only vent his dissatisfaction with roaring. A young man like this has never experienced any major setbacks and cannot correct his position at all.
Ye Feng no longer takes him seriously.
Most people in the world subconsciously think that they are different, even the losers think so.
Zhao Lun felt that he was different and would definitely leave the countryside of Zhaojiazhuang, join the sect and become a peerless master.
So he still reluctantly comforted himself in his heart, as long as he held back this breath, and when his cultivation improved, he would turn around and deal with Ye Feng, making Ye Feng pay a heavy price for what he did today.
Unfortunately, while you are making progress, others are also making progress, and their progress is far faster than you imagine...
…
Zhaojiazhuang.
Outside the door of the dilapidated house where Ye Feng lived, there was a crowd of people. Hundreds of people from the Zhao tribe gathered together in a menacing manner.
"Ye Feng, you killed the deacon, Zhao Hang, Zhao Huo and Zhao Yong in a sneak attack. You deserve death!"
"Get out of here, or we'll burn your doghouse down."
"Trash, trash..."
"Debts must be repaid with blood."
Zhao Hang and others disappeared before, and people in Zhaojiazhuang were panicked. They thought some powerful monsters had escaped from the big black forest.
Unexpectedly, news came just now that it was Ye Feng who killed them. Ye Feng even killed Deacon Zhao, but Young Master Zhao Lun saw it with his own eyes.
At this moment, the entire Zhaojiazhuang exploded. In less than an hour, hundreds of people from the Zhao family gathered. The crowd was so excited that they wanted to cut him into pieces.
